name: leadfeeder
description: Turn website visitor signals into pipeline. Six Leadfeeder-powered skills — Getting Started, Daily Visitor Brief, Visitor Company Brief, Outreach Companion, Find My Buyer, and Add to Pipeline — let you identify high-intent accounts, research buyers, find the right contacts, personalise outreach, and add companies to your lists, all from within Claude. New here? Type "Set up my Leadfeeder brief" to run a 30-second readiness check first.

account_id.title: Leadfeeder Account ID
account_id.description: Your Leadfeeder account ID. To find it, ask Claude to run get_account_info — it will list your available accounts and their IDs. Paste the ID here to skip the account selection prompt in every session and enable fully automated scheduled tasks.
